ideas.name: any warning with MES's box warning the same way
ideas.why: the S&P's own 1m box easing toward the same turn: the turn is index-wide flow, not one market's noise

ideas.name: any warning with MES failing to confirm the extreme
ideas.why: MNQ set a new session high (low) in the last 10 minutes and MES did not: the push is NQ alone, without the broad index's buyers (sellers), and the warning calls it back

ideas.name: any warning against NQ's 15-minute outperformance
ideas.why: NQ ran ahead of ES over 15 minutes (in percent) and the warning calls it back: relative-value desks sell the stretch between the two
